The reading crisis is global!

The reading crisis is global!

The reading crisis is global: in the US, 37% of 4th graders fall below basic reading levels, while UK reading enjoyment hits historic lows. DIGIFOX turns this trend around by boosting skills, comprehension, and joy through adventure

What is the DIGIFOX reading game?

What is the DIGIFOX reading game?

DIGIFOX is an app that helps young school-age children develop their reading skills in a fun and engaging way. This reading app supports the reading and preservation of the Icelandic language.
DIGIFOX er lestrarleikur í formi smáforrits (e. app) sem hjálpar börnum á yngsta skólastigi að þróa lestrarfærni sína á skemmtilegan hátt. Leikurinn styður við lestur og varðveislu íslenskrar tungu. Fyrsta útgáfa mun nýtast börnum í fyrsta bekk.

DIGIFOX is an app that helps young school-age children develop their reading skills in a fun and engaging way. This reading app supports the reading and preservation of the Icelandic language.

A Fun and Gamified World

A Fun and Gamified World

DIGIFOX uses gamification to spark children's interest and create a positive connection with reading. For instance, kids can climb levels, choose their favorite character from DIGIFOX to play, and get rewards by accessing the 'playground' after reading. Doesn't that sound fun?

Get detailed statistics on your child's progress with a smile!

Get detailed statistics on your child's progress with a smile!

With digital technology, we get the opportunity to dive into detailed statistics about reading within the school community. We can analyze things like natural reading speed, reading comprehension, enjoyment of reading, and continuity statistics. Plus, we'll provide comparisons to kids who are at a similar reading level. How exciting is that?

Try the app today!

Try the app today!

Get a detailed and visual overview of your child's progress! Dive into insights about reading minutes, streaks, comprehension, and your child's interests. Clear and simple presentation that helps parents stay in the loop, just like a cheerful learning adventure!
